svg.aria-label: Planket. App Store · web app live. See when your friends are free and send a plan in three taps. Your calendar stays private: friends see busy time, never what you are doing. Built with Next.js, Capacitor and Supabase. The screenshot shows the plan, shared calendar and friends screens.
